optimization.allocation_contract: Pan remained 0 B/op and 0 allocs/op. P720 allocations matched exactly between baseline and candidate at 106402424 B/op and 197 allocs/op.
optimization.correctness_oracle: Compare every carried edge cell against the unchanged full-grid decompTx path, with sentinel guards, legal transform shapes, split masks, clipped extents, and Builder reuse. Integration compares BuildFromMap to ordered decode-time construction for inter blocks, including a partial-frame staircase.
optimization.mechanism: Prune transform-tree recursion to subtrees containing a visible rightmost column or bottom row, since this helper returns only the transform contexts carried to right/below neighbors. The all-zero split-mask case uses the exact uniform intra-edge helper. Split decisions, root offsets, transform classes, and clipped-frame extents remain unchanged.

title: AV1 inter transform edge-context boundary-pruning benchmark evidence

pinned_dav1d.comparison: dav1d recursively fills a full transform grid because mask_edges_inter also derives the block’s internal transform edges; it then copies the last column and row into the carried contexts. This Go helper only prepares those carried boundary contexts, so its pruned walk is narrower in purpose. The oracle preserves dav1d’s boundary values; no claim is made that dav1d’s full-grid work is useless for its broader mask operation.

pinned_svt_av1.comparison: The inspected SVT path reads top/left transform contexts from neighbor arrays. No matching full-grid carried-context builder was identified in the inspected source, so no direct implementation or speed comparison is claimed.
